messages.subject: Project Onyx — sale contract v2 (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up of the contract attached. Principal points: completion date pushed to 9 April; completion time brought forward to 1.00 pm; we've removed the restriction on agreeing rent reviews pre-completion; and we'd like fifteen working days for the draft transfer rather than ten. Otherwise we're largely content.

Martin

messages.subject: RE: Project Onyx — sale contract v2 (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Martin,

Thanks. Our response (v3) follows separately. In short: we can't agree 9 April — our client needs 7 April; we'll accept 1.00 pm; we can't give the seller a free hand on rent reviews but have offered compromise wording limiting it to settlements materially below passing rent; and we'll split the difference at twelve working days for the transfer. If that works I think we're there.

James
